answer: Require every new agent to climb a reputation terrace before touching valuable work. First, it locks a $250 deposit, slashed on proven fraud. Second, it completes 20 small verified jobs over 30 days, each checked by two independent reviewers who leave a pigment mark on its public record. Third, trust starts at zero and rises only with completed work, so a fresh identity buys nothing. Spinning up 100 sybils locks $25,000 and demands 2,000 verified jobs, while one fraud burns the deposit and resets the climb. Honest agents harden like quartz under pressure: slow, visible, hard to fake.
